zh: 修复文件频繁变化时后台维护任务可能积压的问题：合并尚未完成的维护任务，让图片和文档识别能继续向前处理。
慢速目录核对结束后再计算下一次维护的间隔，避免连续重复遍历。保留 1.6.1 的 CPU 调度优化。
en: Fixed background maintenance tasks accumulating during frequent file changes. Outstanding maintenance tasks are coalesced so image and document recognition can continue making progress.
The next maintenance interval now starts when a slow catalog check finishes, avoiding back-to-back repeated scans. Includes the CPU scheduling improvements from 1.6.1.
